scripts.//build:react-panel: React must resolve to ONE copy or hooks throw 'Cannot read properties of null (reading useEffect)' — cfg-react carries react in its own devDeps, so the --alias flags force both it and this bundle onto the plugin's copy (aliases cover subpaths like react/jsx-runtime). NODE_ENV must be defined or React reads `process` in the browser.
scripts.build:bundles: npm run build:three && npm run build:producer && npm run build:terrain-brush && npm run build:terrain-stamp && npm run build:react-panel && npm run build:code-editor
scripts.//dev:react: LOCAL DEV ONLY. Links the sibling cfg-react repo (built) so its edits flow into react-panel.js. Publish cfg-react + switch the devDep off file: before a release.
scripts.dev:react:link: npm --prefix ../cfg-react run build && npm link @crit-fumble/react && npm run build:react-panel
scripts.//dev:shared: LOCAL DEV ONLY. Links the sibling cfg-shared repo so its edits flow into the bundles. NEVER release a bundle built while linked — it may contain UNPUBLISHED shared code. Run dev:shared:unlink + build:bundles from the published package before a plugin release.
scripts.dev:shared:link: npm --prefix ../cfg-shared run build && npm link @crit-fumble/shared && npm run build:bundles
scripts.dev:shared:sync: npm --prefix ../cfg-shared run build && npm run build:bundles
scripts.dev:shared:unlink: npm unlink @crit-fumble/shared --no-save && npm install && npm run build:bundles
scripts.test:foundry:up: npm run test:foundry:stage && docker compose --env-file tests/.env.test -f tests/docker-compose.yml up -d && node tests/integration/shared/foundry-setup.mjs
scripts.test:foundry:down: docker compose --env-file tests/.env.test -f tests/docker-compose.yml down && rm -rf tests/fixtures/.worlds-runtime
scripts.test:foundry:all: npm run test:foundry:up && npm run test:foundry; npm run test:foundry:down
